indexPrompt.es-a-matrix-with-a-dial: One entry of a 2 by 2 matrix is a dial c. Say which c makes its two eigenvalues coincide, find the eigenvectors at that c, and give the eigenvalues at c = -4.
indexPrompt.es-a-server-up-or-down: A server is up or down each day with fixed switching chances. Write the probability of up as a + b mu^n and find the day it first comes within 1e-9 of its long-run value.
indexPrompt.es-psd-square-root: Find the symmetric square root of a covariance matrix, its off-diagonal entry, and every other symmetric matrix with the same square.
indexPrompt.es-smallest-possible-correlation: Two features each correlate 0.9 with a third. Find the smallest their mutual correlation can be, and the smallest eigenvalue when a report says 0.5.
indexPrompt.es-shift-power-iteration: Power iteration on a symmetric matrix with eigenvalues 10, 9 and 1. Find its convergence rate, the shift that speeds it up, and what a shift past the top eigenvalue finds.
indexPrompt.es-similarity-matrix-spectrum: From a 3 by 3 Gram matrix, read off the top eigenvalue of a 1000 by 1000 similarity matrix and the rank-1 truncation errors of both matrices.
